question_en: Which statements are true? 1) If only gravity and elastic forces act, mechanical energy is conserved. 2) With air resistance, the energy of a body thrown vertically is least when it hits the ground. 3) Its kinetic energy is greatest at the top. 4) In an inelastic collision kinetic energy is conserved.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) Faqat og'irlik va elastiklik kuchlari bo'lsa, mexanik energiya saqlanadi. 2) Havo qarshiligida tik otilgan jism energiyasi yerga tushganda eng kichik. 3) Uning kinetik energiyasi eng yuqorida eng katta. 4) Noelastik to'qnashuvda kinetik energiya saqlanadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Если действуют только силы тяжести и упругости, механическая энергия сохраняется. 2) При сопротивлении воздуха энергия тела, брошенного вертикально, наименьшая при падении на землю. 3) Его кинетическая энергия наибольшая вверху. 4) При неупругом ударе кинетическая энергия сохраняется.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Eng yuqori nuqtada Ek = 0 (3 — noto'g'ri); noelastik to'qnashuvda energiyaning bir qismi issiqlikka aylanadi (4 — noto'g'ri).
Asos: E = Ek + Ep.

distractors_ru.A: в верхней точке Ek = 0, утверждение 2 верно

distractors_en.A: at the top Ek = 0 and statement 2 is true
distractors_en.B: statement 1 is true and 4 is false
distractors_en.D: heat is released in an inelastic collision

question_en: A body thrown vertically upwards has, at some moment, kinetic energy $300\ \mathrm{J}$ and potential energy $500\ \mathrm{J}$. A little later its potential energy is $650\ \mathrm{J}$. Find its kinetic energy at that moment ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_uz: Yuqoriga tik otilgan jismning biror paytdagi kinetik energiyasi $300\ \mathrm{J}$, potensial energiyasi $500\ \mathrm{J}$. Bir oz vaqtdan keyin uning potensial energiyasi $650\ \mathrm{J}$ bo'ldi. Shu paytdagi kinetik energiyasini toping ($\mathrm{J}$).
question_ru: У тела, брошенного вертикально вверх, в некоторый момент кинетическая энергия $300\ \mathrm{J}$, потенциальная $500\ \mathrm{J}$. Через некоторое время его потенциальная энергия стала $650\ \mathrm{J}$. Найдите кинетическую энергию в этот момент ($\mathrm{J}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. E = 300 + 500 = 800 J; Ek = 800 − 650 = 150 J.
Asos: Ek + Ep = const.

distractors_en.D: the energies were added instead of subtracted
distractors_en.E: the drop in Ek equals the rise in Ep: 300 − 150

question_en: A body falls freely from rest from height $h$. At what height above the ground is its kinetic energy 2 times its potential energy?
question_uz: $h$ balandlikdan boshlang'ich tezliksiz erkin tushayotgan jismning kinetik energiyasi yerdan qanday balandlikda potensial energiyasidan 2 marta katta bo'ladi?
question_ru: На какой высоте над землёй кинетическая энергия тела, свободно падающего без начальной скорости с высоты $h$, будет в 2 раза больше потенциальной?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Ek = 2Ep ⇒ E = 3Ep, ya'ni mgh = 3mgx, x = h/3.
Asos: Ek + Ep = const.

distractors_en.A: this is the height where Ep = 2Ek
distractors_en.B: this is the height where Ek = Ep
distractors_en.C: this is the height where Ek = 3Ep
distractors_en.E: this is the height where Ep = 3Ek

question_en: A body is thrown upwards with initial speed $v_0$. At what height is its potential energy 4 times its kinetic energy?
question_uz: Yuqoriga $v_0$ boshlang'ich tezlik bilan otilgan jismning potensial energiyasi qanday balandlikda kinetik energiyasidan 4 marta katta bo'ladi?
question_ru: На какой высоте потенциальная энергия тела, брошенного вверх с начальной скоростью $v_0$, будет в 4 раза больше кинетической?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Ep = 4Ek ⇒ E = 5Ep/4; mgh = (4/5)·mv₀²/2, h = 2v₀²/(5g).
Asos: Ek + Ep = const.

distractors_en.A: this is the height where Ek = 4Ep
distractors_en.C: H = v₀²/2g, the factor 2 was dropped
distractors_en.D: this is H/5, the case Ek = 4Ep

question_en: A body is thrown vertically upwards at $16\ \mathrm{m/s}$. At what height is its kinetic energy 3 times its potential energy ($\mathrm{m}$)?
question_uz: Jism $16\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan yuqoriga tik otildi. Qanday balandlikda uning kinetik energiyasi potensial energiyasidan 3 marta katta bo'ladi ($\mathrm{m}$)?
question_ru: Тело брошено вертикально вверх со скоростью $16\ \mathrm{m/s}$. На какой высоте его кинетическая энергия будет в 3 раза больше потенциальной ($\mathrm{m}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. H = v₀²/2g = 12,8 m; Ek = 3Ep ⇒ h = H/4 = 3,2 m.
Asos: h = H/(n + 1).

distractors.C: bu H/3 xato bo'linma bilan topilgan

distractors_en.A: this is H/2, the case Ek = Ep

question_en: A body falls freely from rest from height $h$. What is its speed at the point where its kinetic energy is 3 times its potential energy?
question_uz: Jism $h$ balandlikdan boshlang'ich tezliksiz erkin tushmoqda. Uning kinetik energiyasi potensial energiyasidan 3 marta katta bo'lgan nuqtada tezligi qanday?
question_ru: Тело свободно падает без начальной скорости с высоты $h$. Какова его скорость в точке, где кинетическая энергия в 3 раза больше потенциальной?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Ek = 3Ep ⇒ Ek = 3E/4 = 3mgh/4; mv²/2 = 3mgh/4, v = √(3gh/2).
Asos: Ek + Ep = const.

distractors.B: bu Ek = Ep bo'lgan nuqtadagi tezlik

distractors_ru.B: это скорость в точке, где Ek = Ep
distractors_ru.C: это скорость в точке, где Ep = 3Ek

distractors_en.B: this is the speed where Ek = Ep
distractors_en.C: this is the speed where Ep = 3Ek
distractors_en.E: a wrong result for the case Ek = 2Ep

question_en: When a bullet passes through a board its speed decreases 3 times. What fraction of its initial kinetic energy was spent on piercing the board?
question_uz: Taxtani teshib o'tganda o'qning tezligi 3 marta kamaydi. O'q dastlabki kinetik energiyasining qanday qismi taxtani teshishga sarflangan?
question_ru: При пробивании доски скорость пули уменьшилась в 3 раза. Какая часть начальной кинетической энергии пули затрачена на пробивание доски?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Ek ∼ v²: qolgan energiya E/9, sarflangani E − E/9 = 8E/9.
Asos: Q = E₁ − E₂.

distractors.A: energiya tezlikka emas, uning kvadratiga proporsional

distractors_en.A: energy is proportional to the square of the speed
distractors_en.B: this is the fraction of speed lost
distractors_en.D: this is the fraction of energy left
distractors_en.E: this is the case of the speed halving

question_en: A body is thrown at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal with speed $v_0$. What is its speed at height $h$? $g$ is the free-fall acceleration.
question_uz: Jism gorizontga $\alpha$ burchak ostida $v_0$ tezlik bilan otildi. Uning $h$ balandlikdagi tezligi moduli qanday? $g$ — erkin tushish tezlanishi.
question_ru: Тело брошено под углом $\alpha$ к горизонту со скоростью $v_0$. Каков модуль его скорости на высоте $h$? $g$ — ускорение свободного падения.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. mv₀²/2 = mv²/2 + mgh ⇒ v = √(v₀² − 2gh), burchakka bog'liq emas.
Asos: Ek + Ep = const.

distractors.A: bu faqat eng yuqori nuqtadagi tezlik
distractors.E: gorizontal tezlik o'zgarmaydi, uni kamaytirish xato

distractors_ru.A: это скорость только в верхней точке

distractors_en.A: this is the speed only at the top
distractors_en.B: the speed decreases as the body rises
distractors_en.E: the horizontal velocity does not change

question_en: Through what angle from the vertical must a ball on a $0.45\ \mathrm{m}$ string be deflected and released so that it passes the equilibrium position at $3\ \mathrm{m/s}$?
question_uz: Uzunligi $0.45\ \mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan ipga osilgan sharcha muvozanat vaziyatidan $3\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan o'tishi uchun ipni vertikaldan qanday burchakka og'dirib qo'yib yuborish kerak?
question_ru: На какой угол от вертикали нужно отклонить и отпустить шарик на нити длиной $0.45\ \mathrm{m}$, чтобы он прошёл положение равновесия со скоростью $3\ \mathrm{m/s}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. h = v²/2g = 0,45 m = l ⇒ 1 − cos α = 1, α = 90°.
Asos: h = l(1 − cos α).

distractors_en.A: at 60° h = l/2 and v = 2.1 m/s
distractors_en.D: at 30° the speed is far too small
distractors_en.E: at 15° the speed is far too small

question_en: Balls on strings with length ratio $\frac{l_1}{l_2}=4$ are raised to the horizontal ($90^\circ$) and released. Find the relation between their speeds as they pass the equilibrium position.
question_uz: Uzunliklarining nisbati $\frac{l_1}{l_2}=4$ bo'lgan iplarga osilgan sharchalar gorizontal holatgacha ($90^\circ$) og'dirilib qo'yib yuborildi. Muvozanat vaziyatidan o'tishdagi tezliklari orasidagi munosabatni toping.
question_ru: Шарики на нитях с отношением длин $\frac{l_1}{l_2}=4$ отклонили до горизонтального положения ($90^\circ$) и отпустили. Найдите соотношение их скоростей при прохождении положения равновесия.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. α = 90° da h = l, v = √(2gl) ∼ √l; √4 = 2 ⇒ v₁ = 2v₂.
Asos: mgh = mv²/2.

distractors.B: tezlik l ga emas, √l ga proporsional

distractors_en.A: the speed depends on the string length
distractors_en.B: the speed is proportional to √l, not l
distractors_en.C: the ball on the longer string is faster

question_en: Two identical balls moving along a straight line in the same direction at $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ and $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$ collide perfectly elastically. Find their speeds after the collision ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_uz: Bir to'g'ri chiziq bo'ylab bir yo'nalishda $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ va $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanayotgan ikkita bir xil shar mutlaq elastik to'qnashdi. To'qnashuvdan keyingi tezliklarini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_ru: Два одинаковых шара, движущихся по одной прямой в одном направлении со скоростями $5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ и $2\ \mathrm{m/s}$, столкнулись абсолютно упруго. Найдите их скорости после удара ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Teng massali sharlar elastik to'qnashuvda tezliklarini almashadi: impuls 7 va energiya 29 saqlanadi.
Asos: elastik to'qnashuv.

en: Conservation of momentum and energy: $$u_1+u_2=7,\quad u_1^2+u_2^2=29$$
Solution: the speeds are exchanged: $$u_1=2\ \mathrm{m/s},\quad u_2=5\ \mathrm{m/s}$$

rules.en: Elastic collision: momentum and $E_k$ are conserved

distractors_ru.C: это неупругий удар — энергия не сохраняется

distractors_en.B: this is the case with no collision
distractors_en.C: this is an inelastic collision; energy is not conserved
distractors_en.E: momentum is conserved but the energy would be 25

question_en: A $2\ \mathrm{kg}$ ball moving at $6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ collides head-on and perfectly elastically with a $1\ \mathrm{kg}$ ball at rest. Find the speed of the second ball after the collision ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_uz: $6\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanayotgan $2\ \mathrm{kg}$ massali shar tinch turgan $1\ \mathrm{kg}$ massali shar bilan markaziy mutlaq elastik to'qnashdi. Ikkinchi sharning to'qnashuvdan keyingi tezligini toping ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
question_ru: Шар массой $2\ \mathrm{kg}$, движущийся со скоростью $6\ \mathrm{m/s}$, центрально и абсолютно упруго столкнулся с покоящимся шаром массой $1\ \mathrm{kg}$. Найдите скорость второго шара после удара ($\mathrm{m/s}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. u₂ = 2m₁v₁/(m₁ + m₂) = 24/3 = 8 m/s; u₁ = 2 m/s. Tekshiruv: 36 J = 4 J + 32 J.
Asos: elastik to'qnashuv.

en: Elastic collision with a ball at rest: $$u_2=\frac{2m_1v_1}{m_1+m_2}=\frac{2\cdot2\cdot6}{3}=8\ \mathrm{m/s}$$

distractors_ru.A: это общая скорость при неупругом ударе
distractors_ru.B: скорости меняются только при равных массах

distractors_en.A: this is the common speed in an inelastic collision
distractors_en.B: speeds are exchanged only for equal masses
distractors_en.E: this is the speed of the first ball

question_en: A ball of mass $m$ moving at speed $v$ collides perfectly inelastically with a ball of mass $3m$ at rest. How much heat is released?
question_uz: $v$ tezlik bilan harakatlanayotgan $m$ massali shar tinch turgan $3m$ massali shar bilan mutlaq noelastik to'qnashdi. Bunda qancha issiqlik ajraladi?
question_ru: Шар массой $m$, движущийся со скоростью $v$, абсолютно неупруго столкнулся с покоящимся шаром массой $3m$. Какое количество теплоты выделилось?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. u = v/4; Q = mv²/2 − 4m(v/4)²/2 = mv²/2 − mv²/8 = 3mv²/8.
Asos: Q = E₁ − E₂.

distractors_ru.C: не вся энергия переходит в теплоту

distractors_en.A: this is the kinetic energy after the collision
distractors_en.B: the speed u = v/4 was computed wrongly
distractors_en.C: not all the energy turns into heat

question_en: From what minimum height must a small body slide without friction to go round a loop of radius $24\ \mathrm{cm}$ without leaving it ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_uz: Kichik jism radiusi $24\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan o'lik sirtmoqni ajralmasdan aylanib chiqishi uchun qanday eng kichik balandlikdan ishqalanishsiz sirpanib tushishi kerak ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
question_ru: С какой наименьшей высоты должно соскользнуть без трения маленькое тело, чтобы пройти мёртвую петлю радиусом $24\ \mathrm{cm}$, не отрываясь ($\mathrm{cm}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Yuqorida v² = gR; mgH = 2mgR + mgR/2 ⇒ H = 2,5R = 60 cm.
Asos: mg = mv²/R.

distractors.A: 2R — yuqori nuqtada tezlik nol bo'lib qoladi
distractors.C: bu 3R — yetarli, lekin eng kichik emas

distractors_ru.A: 2R — в верхней точке скорость будет нулевой

distractors_en.A: 2R leaves zero speed at the top
distractors_en.C: 3R is enough but not the minimum
distractors_en.D: at 1.5R the body never reaches the top

question_en: A load attached to a spring on a smooth horizontal rod is pulled $x_0$ from equilibrium and released. At what distance from equilibrium is the kinetic energy of the load 3 times the potential energy of the spring?
question_uz: Silliq gorizontal sterjendagi prujinaga mahkamlangan yuk muvozanat vaziyatidan $x_0$ masofaga tortib qo'yib yuborildi. Muvozanat vaziyatidan qanday uzoqlikda yukning kinetik energiyasi prujina potensial energiyasidan 3 marta katta bo'ladi?
question_ru: Груз, прикреплённый к пружине на гладком горизонтальном стержне, оттянули от положения равновесия на $x_0$ и отпустили. На каком расстоянии от положения равновесия кинетическая энергия груза будет в 3 раза больше потенциальной энергии пружины?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Ek = 3Ep ⇒ E = 4Ep: kx₀²/2 = 4·kx²/2, x² = x₀²/4, x = x₀/2.
Asos: Ep = kx²/2.

distractors.A: energiya x ga emas, x² ga proporsional
distractors.C: x² ni x bilan almashtirib bo'lmaydi

distractors_ru.A: энергия пропорциональна x², а не x

distractors_en.A: the energy is proportional to x², not x
distractors_en.B: this is the point where Ek = Ep
distractors_en.C: x² cannot be replaced by x
distractors_en.D: this is the point where Ep = 3Ek
